newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish state railways reform plan near completion.
newsitem.headline: Turkish state railways reform plan near completion.

text.p: A plan to reform Turkey's loss-making state railway company is near completion, industry officials said on Wednesday.
"The work carried out by the advisory company and the steering committee has reached the final stage," an official told Reuters.
Turkish State Railways (TCDD), with a loss last year of around 60 trillion lira, is one of the most costly of many unprofitable state-owned companies in Turkey.

The reform plan, carried out with $1 million support from the World Bank, entails the drafting of a new railways law, adapting the relationship between the government and TCDD and creating a fresh business plan aimed at raising profitability.
